resources.string: Kosha draws its own controls, so entry feels the same on iOS and Android and never waits for a system picker.
Used everywhere an amount is entered. Digits type straight into the amount, and a fourth column does the maths.
• + − × ÷ work on the amount. Kosha keeps the sum and saves the result.\n• The decimal key follows the currency.\n• Backspace sits in the keypad; hold it to clear.
Account, category, date and note above the payee. Empty is dashed, a guess is grey, a sparkle marks an AI guess.
Quick picks for the usual cases, a month grid for the rest.
Dots mark days that already have entries. Future days stay pickable for planned payments.
A wheel for hours and minutes, drawn by Kosha in the style of iOS.
Flick or drag each wheel, or tap a row to jump to it. 24-hour or AM/PM follows your language.
Each account carries its colour, balance and currency.
Recent first. Archived accounts are left out of quick entry.
Opens from the category tile, or from Next when Kosha can’t guess one. Five a row, most used first.
Picked: accent outline. Guess: dashed, with a sparkle when AI made it. One tap accepts. After Next, picking a tile adds the entry straight away.
Segmented, switch, radio, tick, chip, stepper and buttons.
Rest, focused and with an error.
The system keyboard only ever opens for words: payee, note, names, search, server address and API keys.
One sheet pattern for every picker.
Sheets size to their content, drag down to close and keep the keypad under the thumb. Toasts carry Undo for five seconds. One list picker serves currencies, time zones, languages and “Move to…”.
Enter a full URL, like https://kosha.example.com
